item.title: Is Homeschool Working? How to Check Without Turning Home Into an Inspection
item.description: Danielle and Alex show homeschool parents how to tell what is working without turning home into an inspection: judge progress against your child's own starting point, keep a simple dated portfolio, use teach-back in ordinary moments, do one calmer check every six to eight weeks, know your local requirements, and use a tutor only for a specific gap.
